description: This file defines options and configuration structures for authentication mechanisms in the Kubernetes API server, including request header, client certificate, and delegated authentication, along with related validation and client setup functions.

classes.name: RequestHeaderAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for request header based authentication, including header names, CA file, and validation logic.

classes.name: ClientCertAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for client certificate authentication, including CA bundle and verification provider.

classes.name: DelegatingAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration for delegating authentication to an external kube API server, including kubeconfig, cache, and webhook settings.

methods.name: DefaultAuthWebhookRetryBackoff
methods.description: Returns default backoff parameters for webhook retries used in authentication and authorization.

methods.name: ToAuthenticationRequestHeaderConfig
methods.description: Converts options to a RequestHeaderConfig object if CA file is specified.

methods.name: GetClientCAContentProvider
methods.description: Returns the CA content provider for client certificate verification.

methods.name: NewDelegatingAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DelegatingAuthenticationOptions with default settings.

methods.name: WithCustomRetryBackoff
methods.description: Sets custom backoff parameters for webhook retries.

methods.name: WithRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sets custom timeout for webhook requests.

methods.name: WithCustomRoundTripper
methods.description: Sets custom HTTP middleware for webhook client.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies the authentication options to the server's AuthenticationInfo, configuring authenticators and request header settings.

methods.name: createRequestHeaderConfig
methods.description: Creates a RequestHeaderConfig by querying the cluster for dynamic configuration.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a Kubernetes clientset based on kubeconfig or in-cluster config, with optional custom roundtripper.
